1. Hello, Commander.
This is Tetra Connect, Ark's…

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text:
Hello, Commander.
This is Tetra Connect, Ark's source of entertainment.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: Congratulations on graduating from the military academy.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: We're wondering

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: if you could help us film a Tetra Connect program. That's why we're reaching out to you.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: Is this a good time or...?
Sure.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: The program name is Nikke, the Ethereal Beauty.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: Many people feel sorry for Nikkes.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: They look like ageless beauties that are being used as weapons to reclaim the surface.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: Thus far, over 10,000 Nikkes have been sent to the surface, yet most don't make it back.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: "For Nikkes who know of their destined deaths, they still head out to the surface and fight for the peace of mankind."

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: This is a program about them.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: Are you interested?
I am.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: It's simple.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text:
When you go to the surface next time,
all you have to do is film them in battle.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: What's your current phone model?
SAFE UP-02

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: Ah, Missilis's masterpiece.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: Then use that phone to film.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: A relatively low resolution would be more immersive.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: I'll be waiting.
